answer: A newcomer needs a sponsor staking 90 credits and reputation on a relic plot in the harbor ledger. Each epoch a falcon auditor checks 5% of harbor plots: a copied relic serial or missed work drops the sponsor a step, losing 10%; three drops burn it. Sponsors cap at 3 newcomers; a rented sponsor is slashed with the fake. First fake 50, k-th 50+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,546,500, lock 90,000, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 50 once.
